description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Kaluarachchilage Janaranjana Saman Kumara Kaluarachchi as a member of the Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha - elected Mr. Pushpa Kumara Ranasinghe as Chairman of the Dimbulagala Pradeshiya Sabha - elected Mr. R. Ekanayaka Wikramasingha as a member of the Yatawatta Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to death and removal of officials. It involves electoral processes at the local authority level, including nominations by political parties and declarations of elected members/chairmen under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns filling elected positions in local government bodies through established electoral procedures.
